raw.translational: Understanding the mechanistic link between lysosomal lipid hydrolysis and LDL receptor regulation could inform novel therapeutic strategies. For Wolman disease, therapies aimed at restoring lysosomal lipase activity or managing lipid accumulation are crucial.
